address: 76F, The Standard Bangkok Mahanakhon, 114 Narathiwas Road, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: Offering breathtaking views over the Bangkok cityscape, Ojo has the honour of being Thailand’s highest restaurant. Glamorous pink and gold décor adds to the appeal of a truly special location in which to dine, while the authentic Mexican cooking means this restaurant is far more than just its setting. The menu of attractive dishes includes tender cochinillo and a selection of raw seafood. Ask for a table by the window or on the terrace to make the most of the view....
